Name: Miles Coverdale
Summary: English translator and bishop (1488-1569) who produced the first complete printed Bible in English.
Contribution: His 1535 Coverdale Bible was the first complete English Bible in print, and he later helped produce the Great Bible placed in every parish church under Henry VIII. His psalm translation still echoes in Anglican worship.
Testimony: An exile under Mary I, he returned under Elizabeth I and continued preaching and translating into old age.
